## Change

Describe the user-visible problem and resulting behavior.

## Validation

State checks run and gaps. Distinguish fixtures, real services, packaged CLI and
native-agent validation.

## Compatibility and docs

For public behavior changes, note help/docs, JSON/exit codes, backend requirements,
and changes to source uploads, credentials, drafts or publication. Omit inapplicable
sections. Do not include secrets or customer data.
